threshold: 95% phishing recall on other-source validation, never on excluded source or probes
primary_loss: (equal-source-mean LOSO false-negative rate + equal-source-mean LOSO false-positive rate + everyday MEDIUM-or-HIGH rate)/3
tie_breaker: higher macro-F1 on frozen validation excluding training-only source, then simpler model

provenance.kaggle_arabic_phishing_fully_dataset: translated fraud letters and translated UCI ham; not Egyptian SMS
provenance.kaggle_dialectal_arabic_sms: non-Egyptian; templated; collection/licence unverified; training only
provenance.everyday_probes: 12 existing invented development fixtures; not authentic SMS
